[INBO 2024 — question paper]
26. (1 point) Which of the following statements best describes evolution?
a. Genetic drift is a random process, but mutation and selection are non-random.
b. Mutation and genetic drift are random processes, but selection is non-random.
c. Mutation and selection are random processes, but genetic drift is non-random.
d. Selection is a random process, but mutation and genetic drift are non-random.

favoured them to develop certain characteristics which enable them to live
in water.

B. Which one of the above is the most primitive one? What is its
significance?

evolution of A and F will be

D
